# Meta for Work

> Enterprise VR solutions and managed services for deploying Meta Quest headsets in business environments.

Meta for Work provides virtual reality hardware, management platforms, and business solutions designed for enterprise deployment. The platform enables organizations to leverage immersive technology for training, data visualization, analytics, and collaborative work through Meta Quest headsets and managed device solutions.

## Key Topics

- Meta Quest 3S
- Meta Quest 3
- Meta Horizon managed solutions
- Virtual reality training
- Enterprise VR
- Device management
- MDM integration
- VR data visualization
- Business intelligence
- Immersive technology
- Mixed reality
- User provisioning
- Managed services
- Admin Center
- ArborXR

## Core VR Solutions

- [Virtual reality (VR) headsets for business | Meta for Work](https://forwork.meta.com/?utm_funnel=1&locale=en_GB): Meta for Work homepage showcasing VR solutions for enterprise
- [Meta virtual reality business subscription service | Meta for Work](https://forwork.meta.com/meta-horizon-managed-solutions/?gad_source=1&gclsrc=aw.ds): Meta Horizon managed solutions for deploying and managing Quest headsets

## Industry Applications & Case Studies

- [How BadVR visualises data through VR digital experiences](https://forwork.meta.com/no/en/blog/how-data-visualization-impacts-businesses/): BadVR transforms data visualization with VR and analytics for insights
- [Noda: Transforming learning in virtual reality | Meta for Work](https://forwork.meta.com/se/en/blog/how-noda-is-transforming-learning-in-virtual-reality/): Noda enhances learning and productivity through VR and 3D models
